title: Anaglyph Stereoscopic 3D Red-Cyan Rendering
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive anaglyph stereoscopic 3D scene using Three.js (via CDN). The scene demonstrates red-cyan anaglyph rendering with full user control over stereo parameters and post-processing.

## Scene Setup
- Create a THREE.Scene with a dark background (0x111122).
- Add a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2, 8) looking at origin.
- Place 5 geometric objects in the scene:
  1. A red (0xff3333) TorusKnot at (-3, 1, 0) with args (0.8, 0.3, 100, 16).
  2. A green (0x33ff33) Icosahedron at (3, 1, 0) with radius 1.
  3. A blue (0x3333ff) Box at (0, 1, -3) with size 1.5.
  4. A yellow (0xffff33) Cone at (-1.5, 1, 3) with args (0.7, 2, 8).
  5. A cyan (0x33ffff) Sphere at (1.5, 1, 3) with radius 0.8.
- All objects use MeshStandardMaterial.
- Add a large ground plane (PlaneGeometry 20x20) with MeshStandardMaterial color 0x444466, rotated to be horizontal at y=0.
- Add a DirectionalLight at (5, 10, 5) intensity 1.0 and an AmbientLight intensity 0.3.

## Anaglyph Stereo Rendering
- Implement anaglyph stereoscopic rendering using THREE.AnaglyphEffect from Three.js examples/jsm/effects/AnaglyphEffect.js (import from CDN).
- The AnaglyphEffect should be initialized with the renderer and window size.
- Initial eye separation: 0.064 (standard human IPD in meters).
- The effect renders the scene twice (left eye = red channel, right eye = cyan channel) to produce the classic red-cyan 3D effect.

## User Interactions
1. Eye Separation Control: Press '[' to decrease eye separation by 0.008 (min 0.008), ']' to increase by 0.008 (max 0.200). This controls the stereo depth intensity.
2. Focal Length Control: Press '-' to decrease focal length by 1 (min 5), '=' to increase by 1 (max 50). Initial focal length: 15.
3. Toggle Anaglyph: Press 'Space' to toggle between anaglyph stereo rendering and normal mono rendering. Default: anaglyph ON.
4. Object Rotation Speed: Press 'ArrowUp' to increase rotation speed by 0.005 (max 0.1), 'ArrowDown' to decrease by 0.005 (min 0.0). Initial speed: 0.01.
5. Camera Orbit: Press 'A' to orbit camera left by 15 degrees, 'D' to orbit camera right by 15 degrees around the Y axis at current radius. Camera always looks at origin.
6. Convergence Plane Toggle: Press 'C' to toggle visibility of a semi-transparent convergence plane (a large PlaneGeometry facing camera at the focal distance). Default: hidden.
7. Depth Preset Buttons: Add 3 HTML buttons in a HUD panel:
   - 'Subtle' sets eye separation to 0.032 and focal length to 20.
   - 'Normal' sets eye separation to 0.064 and focal length to 15.
   - 'Extreme' sets eye separation to 0.150 and focal length to 8.

## Animation
- All 5 objects rotate around their local Y axis at the current rotation speed each frame.
- The TorusKnot also bobs up and down with sin(time) * 0.3 offset from its base Y.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left HUD panel (position:fixed, background rgba(0,0,0,0.7), color white, padding 12px, font-family monospace, z-index 100, id='hud-panel').
- Display: Eye Sep: {value.toFixed(3)}, Focal Len: {value}, Mode: Anaglyph|Mono, Rot Speed: {value.toFixed(3)}, Camera Angle: {degrees}°.
- Three buttons with ids: 'btn-subtle', 'btn-normal', 'btn-extreme'.

## State Management (CRITICAL)
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
  - eyeSeparation: current eye separation (number)
  - focalLength: current focal length (number)
  - anaglyphEnabled: boolean
  - rotationSpeed: current rotation speed (number)
  - cameraAngleDeg: camera orbit angle in degrees (number, initial 0)
  - cameraPosition: {x, y, z} of camera
  - convergencePlaneVisible: boolean
  - objectCount: number of scene meshes (should be 5 + ground = 6)
  - objectRotations: array of 5 numbers (current Y rotation of each object)
  - activePreset: 'subtle'|'normal'|'extreme'|'custom' (string)
  - frameCount: incrementing frame counter
  - rendererSize: {width, height}
  - torusKnotY: current Y position of the torus knot
  - effectType: 'anaglyph'|'mono' string
physics_constraints: Eye separation must be clamped to [0.008, 0.200]. Focal length clamped to [5, 50]. Rotation speed clamped to [0.0, 0.1]. Camera orbit maintains constant radius from origin. All numerical state values must be NaN-free. Object rotations must monotonically increase (mod 2π) when speed > 0. TorusKnot Y position must follow sinusoidal pattern bounded within base ± 0.3.
